title: Six Indian species, cut to the beat
caption:
Six Indian species, one beat.

Sloth bears are missing their two upper front teeth, which lets them suck up termites like a vacuum. Their cubs ride on mum's back until they are about 6 to 9 months old.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo, Britannica, IUCN Red List.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
